commands.cmd:
d="$(mktemp -d)" && mkdir "$d/probe" && cp scripts/release_due.py scripts/hardware_profile.py scripts/credential_status.py "$d/probe/" && python3 - "$d/probe" <<'PY'
import json, os, subprocess, sys, time, urllib.request as u
proj = sys.argv[1]
home = os.path.expanduser('~')
env = dict(os.environ, EMBEDDING_PROVIDER='ollama', OLLAMA_MODE='external', OLLAMA_URL='http://127.0.0.1:11434', EMBEDDING_MODEL='qwen3-embedding:4b', EMBEDDING_DIMENSIONS='2560', EMBEDDING_CONTEXT_LENGTH='4096', QDRANT_MODE='external', QDRANT_URL='http://127.0.0.1:6333')
def collections():
    return sorted(c['name'] for c in json.load(u.urlopen('http://127.0.0.1:6333/collections', timeout=30))['result']['collections'])
before = collections()
p = subprocess.Popen(['node', home + '/.local/share/agent-ecosystem/tools/socraticode-1.14.0/node_modules/socraticode/dist/index.js'], stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL, env=env, text=True, cwd=proj)
n = [0]
def call(name, args):
    n[0] += 1
    p.stdin.write(json.dumps({'jsonrpc': '2.0', 'id': n[0], 'method': 'tools/call', 'params': {'name': name, 'arguments': args}}) + '\n'); p.stdin.flush()
    while True:
        m = json.loads(p.stdout.readline())
        if m.get('id') == n[0]:
            r = m.get('result', {})
            return r.get('isError', False), ''.join(c.get('text', '') for c in r.get('content', []) if c.get('type') == 'text')
p.stdin.write(json.dumps({'jsonrpc': '2.0', 'id': 0, 'method': 'initialize', 'params': {'protocolVersion': '2025-03-26', 'capabilities': {}, 'clientInfo': {'name': 'nas-receipt-probe', 'version': '0'}}}) + '\n'); p.stdin.flush()
info = json.loads(p.stdout.readline())['result']['serverInfo']
p.stdin.write(json.dumps({'jsonrpc': '2.0', 'method': 'notifications/initialized'}) + '\n'); p.stdin.flush()
err, _ = call('codebase_index', {'projectPath': proj})
for _ in range(240):
    _, st = call('codebase_status', {'projectPath': proj})
    if 'in progress' not in st and 'Indexed chunks: 0' not in st and 'Indexed chunks:' in st:
        break
    time.sleep(1)
chunks = [l.strip() for l in st.splitlines() if 'chunks' in l.lower()][:1]
def top(q):
    e, t = call('codebase_search', {'query': q, 'projectPath': proj, 'limit': 3})
    return [l.split(' (lines')[0].replace('---', '').strip().split('/')[-1] for l in t.splitlines() if l.startswith('--- ')]
a = top('measure the unified memory and CPU core count of this host')
b = top('is a new release due against the pinned release tag')
c = top('check whether a provider credential file exists without reading its value')
rerr, _ = call('codebase_remove', {'projectPath': proj})
p.stdin.close(); p.terminate()
after = collections()
print(info['name'], info['version'], '| index err', err, chunks, '| top-1:', a[:1], b[:1], c[:1], '| remove err', rerr, '| qdrant collections before/after', len(before), len(after), before == after)
ok = not err and not rerr and a[:1] == ['hardware_profile.py'] and b[:1] == ['release_due.py'] and c[:1] == ['credential_status.py'] and before == after
raise SystemExit(0 if ok else 1)
PY
ok=$?; rm -rf "$d"; exit $ok
